event: Province announces plan to remove bike lanes on Bloor Yonge and University
Bill 212 (Reducing Gridlock Saving You Time Act) receives royal assent
Superior Court grants interlocutory injunction against removal (2025 ONSC 2424)
Superior Court (Schabas J.) finds the removal provisions unconstitutional (2025 ONSC 4397)
Court of Appeal for Ontario allows the province's appeal (Cycle Toronto v Ontario (AG) 2026 ONCA 582)
Province resumes removing the Bloor Street West lanes and restoring motor vehicle lanes
